author: WebBound
description: truyendich.space — TruyenDich.AI, Vietnamese translated/convert/AI novels. Pick the edition by the URL you start from, as on the site: /doc-truyen/<slug> (site default, usually bản dịch), /doc-truyen/ai/<slug> (AI) or /doc-truyen/cv/<slug> (convert). ToC and chapters come from the JSON API (/api/novels/<slug>?edition_type=). The API answers bursts with a human-verification challenge; if chapters fail with 'human verification', pass the check on truyendich.space in the browser and enable Force Hybrid Mode.
